messages.text: What's gone so wrong so quickly at Crystal Palace?

metadata.summary: As Pierre Sage waited to receive the Coupe de France trophy as the victorious manager of RC Lens last May, he turned to his staff and said: "Do you realise where we are?"
metadata.content: Pierre Sage under pressure: How Crystal Palace and last season's Ligue 1 manager of the year are both suffering | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Pierre Sage under pressure: How Crystal Palace and last season's Ligue 1 manager of the year are both suffering Pierre Sage struggling for results at Selhurst Park after loss of Daniel Munoz and Maxence Lacroix plus injury to Ismaila Sarr - but bigger questions remain; watch Crystal Palace vs Liverpool live on Sky Sports Main Event from 12.30pm on Sunday, kick-off 2pm Ron Walker Football Journalist @Ronnabe Sunday 8 November 2026 13:56, UK As Pierre Sage waited to receive the Coupe de France trophy as the victorious manager of RC Lens last May, he turned to his staff and said: "Do you realise where we are?" Sage had just led the club to a first French Cup title in its history while plotting a course to finish second in Ligue 1, its joint-best league position in over two decades - all in his first season in charge. Having managed only 56 professional games prior to joining the club, he had become the rising star of French football almost overnight. Less than six months on, the 47-year-old may be glad he took that moment to embrace the good times.
